review_notes: I read the whole file. It defines one basis, `gradedIdempotentHeadBasis`, and two simp lemmas. It also defines a private abbrev `headFamily`. The basis is built from the library's own `gradedSimpleClassBasis`, and `LaurentK0` and `gradedPositiveMulQuotient` are defined in TauCeti. I found no competing Mathlib, Batteries or core concept. `headFamily` is only a private abbreviation for the subtype-packaged head. It is not a competing concept. I did not examine whether the abbreviation is used consistently elsewhere, and I found nothing that would justify a finding under this rubric.
